scoreMeaning: 8.9/10 for observed static GitHub rendering and production source reuse readiness. This remains an application-specific craft judgment, not a whole-brand, website, audience-recognition or motion-performance score.

confidence.level: High for the inspected local static presentation and verified source identity; moderate for independent rebuild equivalence.
confidence.basis: Independently calculated both vote hashes, verified all 13 source-manifest entries, read all seven changed/new public files, viewed all five required fresh captures, and read all ten updated render-check records.
confidence.limits: The local preview substitutes proposed account fields and data-URL images into GitHub's DOM. This does not establish saved account settings, served image-proxy behavior or physical-device output. PNGs were not independently regenerated in this review.

partnerChallenge.agreement: Both reviewers support the same unchanged renderer, static paired headers and universal day avatar. Both see a compact-detail limitation at the 238 px banner, without a geometry, attachment or crop failure. The dependency-manifest point is a production handoff guardrail rather than a current static defect.
partnerChallenge.difference: A challenged my phrase 'loses hand/wing separation'; I clarified that it describes reduced optical separation, not missing paths or detached parts. I challenged A to distinguish preserved four-wing construction from visibly distinguishable anatomy or tiny-gesture legibility at this size. A explicitly accepted that distinction and retained the optical-detail deduction. A's 9.0 and my 8.9 are independent scoped judgments; neither score is a condition of agreement.

partnerChallenge.exchange: Direct messages exchanged with rigging-a after reading the independently saved reviews. A confirmed acceptance of the same exact recommendation and no remaining substantive objection.

deductions.finding: At the 238 px banner width, mittens/collar and overlapping wing details are optically dense, while the dark antenna connections are subtle. Preserved construction and complete silhouettes do not establish fine anatomical differentiation or gesture recognition at that display size.
deductions.improvementCriterion: Keep this compact full-body lockup decorative and native text authoritative. A future surface requiring finer detail should give the unchanged rig more displayed area or use its existing head crop, then verify the actual minimum size in both themes. No anatomy redraw or current-profile blocker is warranted.
